candidates.statement: Further, the authors of Ref. [@Valderrama:2015] previously argued, on the basis of the wave function anomalous dimension, that the contact operator contributing to the magnetic moment should have a power counting that places it roughly between N2LO and NLO, consistent with the enhancement observed here and in Refs. [@Gnech:2022vwr; @Martin:2023dhl]; however, such an effect could also be due to the implementation of cutoffs that are too soft, causing an uncontrolled sensitivity to the short-range physics [@Hammer:2019poc].
